## Summary

The IEEE registry lists three MA-L blocks, 1C-4E-A2, 34-1F-C4 and 70-3A-2D, under "Shenzhen V-Link Technology CO., LTD." at Room 1803, BaiRuiDa Building, Bantian Sub-district, Longgang District, Shenzhen [1]. MAC Lookup shows the same registrant and address for a further MA-L block, F4-BD-AE, which it dates to July 2026 and which is not yet in the registry copy used here [2].

No company website, Wikipedia article, teardown or security advisory for this firm was found, and the FCC ID databases refused fetches from this session, so what its devices are, their radios and silicon, its FCC grantee code and its randomization behaviour are all left unknown rather than guessed. Similarly named Shenzhen firms (Vision-Link, Via-link, Smart Link) are different companies and were not used.
